name: almanac
description: Local-only heatmaps and streaks for how you actually work — days, languages, projects and hours, tracked honestly.

commands.title: Almanac: Export my data to JSON

almanac.tracking.enabled.description: Track activity. Turn off to stop recording entirely; existing data is kept until you delete it.

almanac.trackProjects.markdownDescription: Record which project you worked on, by **workspace folder name only** — never the path, never file names. Turn off if a folder name would say more than you want.

almanac.trackGitCommits.description: Count commits you authored in open repositories, read through VS Code's built-in Git extension.

almanac.streak.minMinutes.description: Minutes of active work a day needs before it counts towards a streak.

almanac.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the current streak and today's active time in the status bar.

almanac.retentionDays.description: How many days of history to keep. Older days are deleted.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run compile && esbuild test/*.test.ts --bundle --outdir=dist/test --out-extension:.js=.cjs --platform=node --format=cjs && node --test dist/test/*.test.cjs
